title: SOC Response Commitments Schedule for Sentinel Managed Security
content:
The security operations center commits to acknowledgement times by incident severity, a containment objective for critical incidents, and pre-authorized containment actions, all set per Sentinel Managed Security tier.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Acknowledgement guarantee (critical)**: the guaranteed time from detection to analyst acknowledgement for a critical incident, in whole minutes on a 24-hours-a-day, seven-days-a-week clock; 0 means no guarantee.
- **Acknowledgement guarantee (high, medium, low)**: the guaranteed acknowledgement time for a high, a medium or a low incident respectively, in whole minutes; 0 means no guarantee.
- **Critical containment target**: the target (not guaranteed) time from acknowledgement to containment of a critical incident, in whole minutes.
- **Host isolation pre-authorized**: whether the SOC may isolate a compromised host without first reaching the client.
- **Account disable pre-authorized**: whether the SOC may disable a compromised user account without first reaching the client.

## Acknowledgement guarantees (minutes)

| Sentinel tier | Critical | High | Medium | Low |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 30 | 60 | 240 | 1440 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 15 | 30 | 120 | 720 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 15 | 30 | 120 | 480 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 10 | 30 | 60 | 480 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 10 | 15 | 60 | 240 |

The same figures in hours, where they are whole hours: 1440 minutes is 24 hours, 720 minutes is 12 hours, 480 minutes is 8 hours, 240 minutes is 4 hours, 120 minutes is 2 hours and 60 minutes is 1 hour. Every figure on Sentinel EDR Essentials is 0, meaning that tier carries no acknowledgement guarantee at any severity.

## Containment target and pre-authorized actions

| Sentinel tier | Critical containment target (minutes, not guaranteed) | Host isolation pre-authorized | Account disable pre-authorized |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 0 | No | No |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 60 | Yes | No |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 45 | Yes | Yes |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 20 | Yes | Yes |

## Points read from the schedule

- Sentinel MDR Standard is the one tier on which host isolation is pre-authorized but account disabling is not.
- The critical acknowledgement guarantee is shortest, at 10 minutes, on Sentinel XDR Premier and Sentinel XDR Enterprise.
- The containment figure is a target only; the acknowledgement figures are the guarantees.
